mentions.name: Video Hub App
mentions.description: Video Hub App is a desktop application for browsing, searching, and organizing video collections on Windows, Mac, and Linux, released as MIT-licensed open source. It is currently being ported from Electron to Tauri to shrink the installer from 400 MB to 40 MB.
mentions.problem: The Electron-based installer is large (~400 MB); porting to Tauri reduces it to about 40 MB.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Trying to port over Video Hub App from Electron to Tauri (400mb -> 40mb installer)

https://videohubapp.com/ - Browse, search, and organize your videos on Win, Mac, and Linux

https://github.com/whyboris/Video-Hub-App - MIT open source!
mentions.author: yboris
